RESOLUTION NO. 20|5-0a-03

A RESOLUTION TO AUTHORIZE THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY, ON BEHALF OF THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA, TO ADOPT AN AMENDMENT TO THE TOWN CHARTER FOR THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA, AND REPLACING THE OLD TOWN
1: APPROVED ON APRIL 5, 1994 (Ga.L. 1994, p. 4782), AS AMENDED; TO
7:
The Town of Clermont, Georgia, by and through its duly authorized Town Council, does hereby request and authorize the local legislative delegation to introduce a bill in the Georgia General Assembly to adopt an amendment to the Town Charter for the Town of Clermont, Georgia except that said amendment shall not affect the current municipal boundaries of the Town. The local legislative delegation is requested and authorized to tender either a House Bill or Senate Bill to the General Assembly of Georgia providing for said amendment to the Charter upon the approval of the General Assembly, and with the local act being substantially similar to the draft local act which is attached to this resolution as Exhibit 1 and incorporated by reference hereinto, into this resolution. However, the local legislative delegation is authorized to change the provisions of this proposed local act in any procedural manner, in order to comply with the requirements of the Georgia General Assembly regarding local acts.

- (b) The Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia does also hereby approve any changes recommended by the local legislative delegation in order to pass the proposed local act.
8:
PERFORM NECESSARY ACTS TO COMPLETE THE PASSAGE AND IMPLEMENTATION OF THE LOCAL ACT.

The Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia does hereby authorize the local legislative delegation, and the appropriate agents of the Town of Clermont, Georgia including but not limited to the Mayor, Town Clerk, Deputy Town Clerk, and the Town Attorney, to perform and do any and all necessary acts in order to have passage of a local act providing for an amendment to the charter for the Town of Clermont, with said acts including but not limited to the passage of this resolution, certification of this resolution, any and all acts by the local

legislative delegation to have the General Assembly pass a local act adopting new provisions for the charter for the Town of Clermont, Georgia by way of an amendment, and for agents of the Town to perform any and all acts to complete the adoption of the amendment to the Charter.
9: This resolution shall be effective upon passage.
10:
Any and all prior resolutions or any parts thereof that are in conflict with this resolution are repealed to the extent of the conflict.

SO RESOLVED, this 2 ih of Fe by ary , 2015.
